description: Source code for switch configuration API (user space part), including netlink communication, attribute handling, and device management functions.

methods.name: swlib_alloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory of specified size.

methods.name: wait_handler
methods.description: Handler for waiting for netlink message acknowledgment.

methods.name: swlib_call
methods.description: Performs a netlink request with specified command and callbacks.

methods.name: send_attr
methods.description: Serializes switch attribute into netlink message.

methods.name: store_port_val
methods.description: Stores port values from netlink attribute into switch_val structure.

methods.name: store_link_val
methods.description: Stores link attribute values into switch_val structure.

methods.name: store_val
methods.description: Parses netlink message to populate switch_val structure.

methods.name: swlib_get_attr
methods.description: Retrieves attribute value for a switch device.

methods.name: send_attr_ports
methods.description: Serializes port list attribute into netlink message.

methods.name: send_attr_link
methods.description: Serializes link attribute into netlink message.

methods.name: send_attr_val
methods.description: Serializes switch_val attribute into netlink message.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr
methods.description: Sets attribute value for a switch device.

methods.name: swlib_set_attr_string
methods.description: Sets attribute value from string input, handling different attribute types.

methods.name: add_id
methods.description: Adds attribute ID to netlink message.

methods.name: add_attr
methods.description: Adds attribute data from netlink message to switch_attr structure.

methods.name: swlib_scan
methods.description: Scans and populates switch device attributes.

methods.name: swlib_lookup_attr
methods.description: Finds attribute by name within a switch device.

methods.name: swlib_priv_free
methods.description: Frees internal netlink objects and caches.

methods.name: swlib_priv_init
methods.description: Initializes netlink socket and retrieves switch family.

methods.name: add_port_map
methods.description: Adds port mapping information to switch device.

methods.name: add_switch
methods.description: Adds switch device info from netlink message.

methods.name: list_switch
methods.description: Lists switches by querying netlink.

methods.name: swlib_list
methods.description: Public function to list all switches.

methods.name: swlib_print_portmap
methods.description: Prints port mapping info for a device.

methods.name: swlib_connect
methods.description: Connects to a switch device by name.

methods.name: swlib_free_attributes
methods.description: Frees attribute list.

methods.name: swlib_free_port_map
methods.description: Frees port map data.

methods.name: swlib_free
methods.description: Frees switch device and associated data.

methods.name: swlib_free_all
methods.description: Frees a list of switch devices.
